blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — ARQ Boxing Stable’s April Jay “Astroboy” Abne faces a tough challenge in his comeback fight when he takes on undefeated American prospect Diego Aviles in Tokyo, Japan, this Sunday, November 29. Abne, the older brother of fellow hard-hitting boxer Ian Abne, will face the 20-year-old Aviles in a six-round bout on […]...
